title: Occupational Hygiene Monitoring Summary: Hazardous Chemical Agents
subtitle: Solvent vapour survey, spray booth and mixing room, Coastal Coatings, Jacobs, Durban. Survey of 3 and 4 February 2026

blocks.p: This summary records the airborne solvent exposure survey in the spray booth and paint mixing room, done because the company's risk assessment identified hazardous chemical agents in the paints and thinners used. It sits in front of the full survey report in this section and tells the reader what was measured, by whom, what the approved inspection authority concluded, and what the company did about it.

rows: Umgeni Occupational Hygiene (Pty) Ltd (fictitious), an approved inspection authority for hazardous chemical agents; approval certificate on file with the report
Occupational hygienist who signed the report
Priya Govender (fictitious), registered occupational hygienist; registration proof on file with the report
Sanele Mthembu, Health and Safety Officer

bullets: Personal air samples in the breathing zone of spray painters and the paint mixer over a full shift on both days
Static samples at the spray booth doorway and in the mixing room
Solvent components named in the safety data sheets of the paints and thinners in use
Airflow at the spray booth extraction face

blocks.h2: 4. Results as the approved inspection authority reported them

blocks.p: The limits used and the interpretation are the approved inspection authority's, from its report. This summary does not add limits of its own.

rows: Within the occupational exposure limits for all agents measured, while wearing the supplied respirators
Spray booth extraction; supplied air respirators; coveralls and gloves
One agent above the occupational exposure limit on 4 February during bulk thinning
General ventilation only; half mask respirator worn part of the shift
Below the design airflow stated by the booth supplier at two of six points
Local exhaust ventilation hood fitted over the mixing bench, designed and tested by a ventilation contractor
Paint mixer to wear the respirator for all thinning until the retest confirms the new extraction works; fit test done
Spray booth filters changed and airflow rebalanced; filter changes added to the maintenance plan
Retest of the paint mixer and the mixing room by the approved inspection authority after the new hood
Closed; retest of 21/04/2026 reported within the occupational exposure limits
Survey results shared with the occupational medical practitioner, who set the medical surveillance for the exposed groups; outcomes only (fit, fit with restrictions, unfit) are filed in Section E
Results explained to the affected employees and the health and safety representative; attendance register filed

blocks.p: The next survey is done at the interval the approved inspection authority recommends in its report and the registered Health and Safety practitioner confirms, and sooner if a product, process or control changes. The due date is entered in the occupational hygiene survey programme at the front of this section.
